sourceQuery.rawQuery:
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) AS TotalAssets,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP1
                WHERE AP1.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP1.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by'
            )
            AND (
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP2
                    WHERE AP2.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                      AND AP2.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by'
                )
                OR EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP3
                    WHERE AP3.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                      AND AP3.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by'
                )
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithCompleteCoverage,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP4
                WHERE AP4.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP4.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithoutOwner,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP5
                WHERE AP5.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP5.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithoutSupport,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP6
                WHERE AP6.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP6.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithoutManager,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP7
                WHERE AP7.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP7.`PersonRole` IN (
                      'Owned by',
                      'Supported by',
                      'Managed by'
                  )
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithoutAnyRelationship,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP8
                WHERE AP8.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP8.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by'
            )
            OR (
                NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP9
                    WHERE AP9.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                      AND AP9.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by'
                )
                AND NOT EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP10
                    WHERE AP10.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                      AND AP10.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by'
                )
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS AssetsWithRelationshipGap,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE (
            100 * COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP11
                        WHERE AP11.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                          AND AP11.`PersonRole` IN (
                              'Owned by',
                              'Supported by',
                              'Managed by'
                          )
                    )
                    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
                END
            )
            +
            60 * COUNT(
                DISTINCT CASE
                    WHEN EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP12
                        WHERE AP12.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                          AND AP12.`PersonRole` IN (
                              'Owned by',
                              'Supported by',
                              'Managed by'
                          )
                    )
                    AND (
                        NOT EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP13
                            WHERE AP13.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                              AND AP13.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by'
                        )
                        OR (
                            NOT EXISTS (
                                SELECT 1
                                FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP14
                                WHERE AP14.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                                  AND AP14.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by'
                            )
                            AND NOT EXISTS (
                                SELECT 1
                                FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` AP15
                                WHERE AP15.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                                  AND AP15.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by'
                            )
                        )
                    )
                    THEN BE.`Instance Id`
                END
            )
        ) / COUNT(DISTINCT BE.`Instance Id`)
    END AS AccountabilityRiskScore
FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:BaseElement` BE
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
    )
    AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `AR System Schema`.`AST:AssetPeople` APP
            WHERE APP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
              AND APP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
        )
    )

SELECT
    BE.`Name` AS AssetName,
    BE.`Short Description` AS AssetDescription,
    BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` AS AssetType,
    BE.`Class Id` AS Class,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity` AS Instance,
    BE.`Serial Number` AS SerialNumber,
    BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` AS AssetLifecycleStatus,
    BE.`Model Number` AS Product,
    BE.`MarketVersion` AS Version,
    BE.`Installation Date`,
    AP.PersonRole,
    AP.`Full Name`,
    BE.Company

FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE

INNER JOIN `AST:AssetPeople` AP
    ON BE.`Reconciliation Identity` = AP.`AssetInstanceId`

WHERE
   (${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'True' OR (AP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
    AND (${Relationship:singlequote} = 'All Relationships' OR AP.`PersonRole` = $Relationship)))
    --AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
    )

GROUP BY
    BE.`Name`,
    BE.`Short Description`,
    BE.`UserDisplayObjectName`,
    BE.`Class Id`,
    BE.`Reconciliation Identity`,
    BE.`Serial Number`,
    BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus`,
    BE.`Model Number`,
    BE.`MarketVersion`,
    BE.`Installation Date`,
    AP.PersonRole,
    AP.`Full Name`,
    BE.Company

SELECT
    MAX('Owned by') AS Relationship,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP1
                WHERE AP1.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP1.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Assigned,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP2
                WHERE AP2.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP2.`PersonRole` = 'Owned by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Missing
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
    )
    AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'true'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `AST:AssetPeople` APP
            WHERE APP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
              AND APP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
        )
    )
UNION ALL
SELECT
    MAX('Supported by') AS Relationship,
    COUNT(

            WHEN EXISTS (

                WHERE AP3.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP3.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Assigned,
    COUNT(

            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP4
                WHERE AP4.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP4.`PersonRole` = 'Supported by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Missing
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
    )
    AND (
        ${ShowEverything:singlequote} = 'true'
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `AST:AssetPeople` APP
            WHERE APP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
              AND APP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
        )
    )
UNION ALL
SELECT
    MAX('Managed by') AS Relationship,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP5
                WHERE AP5.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP5.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Assigned,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP6
                WHERE AP6.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP6.`PersonRole` = 'Managed by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Missing
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'
        OR BE.`Mark As Deleted` IS NULL
    )
    AND (

        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM `AST:AssetPeople` APP
            WHERE APP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
              AND APP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
        )
    )
UNION ALL
SELECT
    MAX('Approved by') AS Relationship,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP7
                WHERE AP7.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP7.`PersonRole` = 'Approved by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Assigned,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP8
                WHERE AP8.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP8.`PersonRole` = 'Approved by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Missing
FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
    AND BE.`AssetLifecycleStatus` = 'Deployed'
    AND (
        BE.`Mark As Deleted` = 'No'

    AND (

        OR EXISTS (

            WHERE APP.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
              AND APP.`Full Name` IN ($Portfolio)
        )

UNION ALL
SELECT
    MAX('Used by') AS Relationship,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `AST:AssetPeople` AP9
                WHERE AP9.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP9.`PersonRole` = 'Used by'
            )
            THEN BE.`Instance Id`
        END
    ) AS Assigned,
    COUNT(
        DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN NOT EXISTS (

                WHERE AP10.`AssetInstanceId` = BE.`Reconciliation Identity`
                  AND AP10.`PersonRole` = 'Used by'
            )

        END

FROM `AST:BaseElement` BE
WHERE
    BE.`Data Set Id` = 'BMC.ASSET'
    AND BE.`UserDisplayObjectName` IN ($AssetType)
